For each document it records where the official copy lives (the pediatric office, the state immunization registry, the filing cabinet), the date on it, and the date it stops being accepted. CDC says it holds no vaccination records and points parents to the child's doctor, the state immunization information system and the school, so the page notes which of those worked last time. A dated row per form in the household store (F031) drives the reminders: 'the physical on file is older than this camp accepts, book a visit' and 'forms due in 14 days'.
